stage.name: Seize the Day
stage.description:
What you do with an opportunity is often what decides victory or defeat. This is the chance for your players to show their quality.
<Twister Field> A moving tornado will appear, causing nearby enemies to levitate.
<Mercy Rule> First team to get a 5-goal lead wins.

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_2.name: Originium Slug α
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_2.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than a normal Originium Slug. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

acid_originium_slug_enemy_1004_mslime.name: Acid Originium Slug
acid_originium_slug_enemy_1004_mslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that can secrete corrosive fluids strong enough to dissolve armor. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

abnormal_originium_slug_enemy_10126_rkbo.name: Abnormal Originium Slug
abnormal_originium_slug_enemy_10126_rkbo.flavourText: These Originium slugs have mutated due to the environmental changes in the mines, caused by an unknown substance. Approach with care, as they are highly unstable.
abilities: More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and deals Arts damage to the attacker when attacked
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug
infused_originium_slug_enemy_1021_bslime.flavourText: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
abilities: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug
infused_glacial_originium_slug_enemy_106.flavourText: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
abilities: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.name: Originium Slug β
originium_slug_enemy_1007_slime_3.flavourText: An infected wild creature that is more dangerous than an Originium Slug α. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

field_goalie.name: Field Goalie
field_goalie.flavourText: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

bloated_beetleball.name: Bloated Beetleball
bloated_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, to scare away predators, but this just makes it all the more adorable to those present.
abilities: Becomes bigger when kicked, requiring more damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

deep_sea_slider_ball.name: Deep Sea Slider Ball
deep_sea_slider_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of a strange sea creature. Like its inspiration, it excretes a mucous slime, but it is unable to slide smoothly. Instead, it gets stuck in its own slime all the time.
abilities: Leaves behind sticky slime on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

floating_charged_ball.name: Floating Charged Ball
floating_charged_ball.flavourText: Football inspired by a flying machine in order to enrich the match experience. Its complex kinetic structure allows it to fly for extended periods when enough force is applied... What was its original purpose again?

leaking_beetleball.name: Leaking Beetleball
leaking_beetleball.flavourText: An Originium beetle plays the part of the football. It sucks in air to expand rapidly when it feels threatened, but this one seems to have a leak and keeps getting flatter as it rolls.
abilities: Becomes smaller when kicked, requiring less damage to move
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

will_of_the_north_ball.name: Will of the North Ball
will_of_the_north_ball.flavourText: A ball made in the image of the indomitable will of the north. Like its inspiration, its mere presence summons snow and ice. Anyone up for a game of ice hockey?
abilities: Leaves behind slippery ice on the ground
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

pompeii.name: 'Pompeii'
pompeii.flavourText: A massive infected beast. These aberrations were born in a special high-temperature environment. Nobody wants to approach these creatures due to their grotesque appearance and the extreme heat they give off. The existence of these giant creatures has been known since ancient times, but to see one warped by infection is terrifyingly unforgettable...
abilities: Can attack up to 4 targets at once and ignites targets it attacks, dealing Immolation damage over time
Self-immolates when blocked, dealing heavy damage
Gains significantly increased ASPD when HP drops to half
